onboarding.title: Set up your POS
onboarding.subtitle: A few simple steps, then you’re ready to work.
onboarding.languageHelp: Choose the language for this terminal. You can change it later in Settings.
onboarding.connectionIntro: Link this POS to your business using its connection code.
onboarding.connectionStringHelp: In the Admin Dashboard, open Branches → POS and copy this terminal’s full connection code.
onboarding.connectionStringPlaceholder: Paste your full connection code here
onboarding.rawKeyHint: Use the full connection code, not the API key shown separately.
onboarding.previewHelp: Check the terminal and server before connecting.
onboarding.previewPending: Your terminal and server will appear here when you paste a valid code.
onboarding.invalidConnectionString: This connection code is incomplete or invalid. Copy the full code again from the Admin Dashboard.
onboarding.rawApiKeyDetected: This looks like an API key. Copy the full connection code from Admin Dashboard → Branches → POS.
onboarding.syncFailed: The connection was saved, but settings could not be synced.
onboarding.retryHint: Check your internet connection and confirm the code is current, then try again.
onboarding.syncRetryHint: Check your internet connection and try again to finish syncing.
onboarding.recoveryHelp: Use local backups and recovery tools.
onboarding.privacyHint: Your connection code contains private credentials. Keep it safe.
